newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 3.774 billion yuan from 2.877 billion on Tuesday and the most active one was the 60-day contract.
Traders said the bullish A share market remained the most important factor supporting the rates.

"The strong performance in the domestic A share market recently is the key factor for active trading, and a number of new A share issues in the next few days will surely support the rates," one local trader said.
"Non-banking financial institutions were seen borrowing money heavily from short-term financial centres to invest in A shares," a second trader said.
